speaker: Rafael Costa (Vendor)

text: Yep, got it, read it. So that one's done as far as I'm concerned, the summary is there.

text: Yes, I have it too. Before we go through it, can we close out a couple of things from Monday first?

text: Sure. So I went through the METCO bill. We are paying for forty two services on the tagged template and none on PRIORITY-MARK mapped. So it is only tagged, forty two of them. I sent the list to Rafael this morning.

text: Yes, I received it, thank you Marty.

text: Good, so that action is closed. And on the CR, I have put the tagged mode support on the CR list, and the business have asked for the options and the vendor estimate before they decide, so that one is in progress, it is with Rafael for the estimate now.

text: And the port default. I took the one port or four port question to the business on Tuesday and they decided to keep one port as the default. They do not want to change what we send to customers. So that is decided, we keep one port.

text: Good, that is the right call, that is what we do today anyway.

text: Okay, so the default stays one port, and we do not need the four port default rule. Noted.

text: Now on the capacity of the GEN-1, I checked the METCO specification. The GEN-1 ACCESS-TYPE-A is 1.3 gig downstream and the GEN-1 ACCESS-TYPE-B is 1 gig downstream. So it is confirmed, it is in the spec, page twelve.

text: Yep, I have the same spec open, 1.3 and 1 gig. Confirmed.

speaker: Rafael Costa (Vendor)
text: And I asked NETCO about the connect outstanding. They came back and said connect outstanding allows an entity replace for both ACCESS-TYPE-A and ACCESS-TYPE-B, because the premises may have an old device left behind by the previous occupant. So it is both, not only ACCESS-TYPE-B.

speaker: Martin Vasquez
text: Makes sense. So that question is answered then.

text: Now the charge risk you raised, Marty, the three hundred dollar one. speaker: Martin Vasquez
text: Yes, that is what I want. A manual approval step on anything chargeable. Then we are not burning revenue by accident.

speaker: Elena Marchetti
text: Agreed, let us review that risk again at the end of the month once the flow is designed.

speaker: Rafael Costa (Vendor)
